description: Ready-to-send request messages for manual gRPC testing of cashier.v1.CashierService (grpcurl or Postman). Replace the <PLACEHOLDERS>. Schema: cashier-service.grpc.schema.json. Never commit a real service key.

placeholders.<TENANT_ID>: UUID of an active tenant with F&B enabled and some products/orders
placeholders.<OTHER_TENANT_ID>: UUID of a different active tenant (isolation checks)
placeholders.<OTHER_TENANT_ORDER_NUMBER>: an existing order number that belongs to <OTHER_TENANT_ID>

GetCatalogItem.name: search by name or category
GetCatalogItem.expect: OK, at most 5 items matching name or category

GetCatalogItem.name: search is case-insensitive and trimmed
GetCatalogItem.expect: OK, same items as the lowercase query

GetCatalogItem.name: LIKE wildcards are escaped
GetCatalogItem.expect: OK, empty items (a literal percent sign, not match-all)

GetCatalogItem.name: blank tenant
GetCatalogItem.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must not be blank

GetCatalogItem.name: tenant is not a UUID
GetCatalogItem.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must be a valid UUID

GetCatalogItem.name: unknown tenant
GetCatalogItem.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED: Tenant is not permitted for this service (same message as an inactive tenant)

GetOrderStatus.name: existing order
GetOrderStatus.expect: OK with status (OPEN, COMPLETED or CANCELLED), paymentStatus, totalAmount (string), createdAt (UTC ISO-8601)

GetOrderStatus.name: tenant isolation: order of another tenant
GetOrderStatus.expect: NOT_FOUND (must never return the other tenant's order)

GetOrderStatus.name: blank order number
GetOrderStatus.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: order_number must not be blank

GetOrderStatus.name: missing order number
GetOrderStatus.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: order_number must not be blank

GetOrderStatus.name: blank tenant
GetOrderStatus.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tenant_id must not be blank

authAndLimits.name: no x-internal-service-key header
authAndLimits.expect: UNAUTHENTICATED: Invalid or missing service credentials

authAndLimits.name: burst above 50 requests per second
authAndLimits.expect: Some calls return RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Rate limit exceeded
